fields.value: Transfer Learning Model in Teaching and Learning English as a Foreign Language could be Married

dsDescriptionValue.value:
The essay on "transfer learning" aims to provide
fundamental concepts for the range of English language
teaching and learning, particularly at the university level
and for English for specialized purposes. Consequently, the
topic of this article is "transfer learning" and integrated
learning design.
